script_text: Pisces, the cosmic tide pulls you into a week where watery illusion meets reality. On Monday, the Sun in your 5th House of romance forms a trine to Neptune, your ruling planet in the 1st House, flooding love with soulful connection. By Wednesday, Mercury square Saturn in your 2nd House of money signals delays in a career financial negotiation. The key turning point strikes Thursday as Mars in your 7th House of partnerships opposes Neptune, shattering rosy illusions about a business alliance. Friday sees Venus enter your 4th House, soothing domestic ripples and inviting tender weekend intimacy. Sunday’s Sun sextile to Jupiter in your 6th House of work magnifies career praise for your diligent service. Tuesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Pluto, amplifying magnetic creative expression. Thursday is your worst day because Mars opposite Neptune clouds judgment in signed contracts. List career goals now. Follow for daily updates.
